source.check: returned unopposed after the withdrawal of the only other nominee, W. J. Halfpenny, on 8 May 1930 (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1930)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council on the 20 single-member county electoral divisions; nominations received by R. J. Dickson at Downpatrick. No poll: the only division with two nominations was Downpatrick, and W. J. Halfpenny withdrew there on 8 May 1930, so all twenty were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 2 and 9 May 1930). No party labels are printed, so none are given. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Mr. W. J. Halfpenny also nominated; he withdrew on 8 May 1930, leaving Brown returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1930). Returned unopposed.
